{{Top|leg}}
'''Hbuuga''' were [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-laying creatures. Their eggs could be cooked to create a caviar favored by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> 12 barrels od Hbuugas' caviar where served at the [[wedding of Gorga the Hutt and Anachro the H'uun]].<ref name="Boba Fest">''[[Star Wars: Boba Fett: Death, Lies, & Treachery]]''</ref>
